reader.requirement: For an indexed file at --std 85 the compiler must accept ACCESS [MODE] [IS] followed by exactly one of SEQUENTIAL, RANDOM or DYNAMIC (MODE and IS optional, not underlined), refuse any other word or an empty choice, assume sequential when the clause is omitted (IX.2.4.4 GR1), and give each mode its access semantics (GR2-GR4).

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 a READ of an ACCESS MODE DYNAMIC file that writes AT END must write NEXT (§1985:IX.4.5.3 SR5); 2002+ imply NEXT. Downstream of the clause (the READ verb's own rule), reached only because the mode is DYNAMIC
the per-edition RECORD KEY / ALTERNATE KEY rule table screened on the same entry; switches nothing about ACCESS MODE
DYNAMIC reserved at all four editions

reader.edition-search: Grammar rules accessModeClause/accessMode carry no predicate; grep of FileControlBinder.cs for DialectLevel|Year|Constructs. found only the PADDING gate (line 185); VersionConformancePass has no ACCESS MODE visit (VisitRelativeKeyClause is relative-file only).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the clause itself (ix1 prints identical output at --std 2023); downstream, the 1985 READ of a DYNAMIC file needs an explicit NEXT for sequential retrieval
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses exercise RANDOM/DYNAMIC on relative/sequential entries and ASSIGN forms; omitted MODE/IS words, the omitted clause defaulting to sequential, and a refused non-mode word are not exercised

reader.notes: The grammar is the format exactly (ACCESS MODE? IS? {SEQUENTIAL|RANDOM|DYNAMIC}) and MapAccessMode maps the three words; nothing on the clause path depends on the edition. Diagnostics at --std 85 cite §2023 clause numbers, which is cosmetic for this rule.
reader.at-2023: ix1 prints the same six lines at --std 2023

refuter.evidence: Probes under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-085/ at --std 85. ax1.cob (e): ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC indexed file, START + READ NEXT gives 001AAAAA, then a READ with no NEXT and no KEY phrase after a NEXT read is a random read by the record key (003CCCCC, status 00), READ NEXT after it gives EOF status 10 (003 is last), a missing key gives INVALID/23; ACCESS IS SEQUENTIAL (MODE omitted) reads in ascending key order 001,002 although written 002,001,003 (GR2, GR4). ax2bad.cob (b): an ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM indexed file in SORT USING/GIVING is refused COBOL1757 (SR1, which the reader cited but did not probe). ax3bad.cob (b,c): a RELATIVE KEY phrase on an indexed file's ACCESS clause (only the relative format prints it) is refused COBOL0863; the clause written twice is refused COBOL2423.
